title: Diagnostic Agreement Between a General-Purpose AI Model and Retinal Specialists in Color Fundus Photography-A Pilot Study.
summary: A single-prompt Gemini 2.5 Flash image interpretation was compared with retinal specialists on 66 fundus photographs from 35 patients; agreement with the context-informed reference specialist was low (Gwet AC2 −0.58). The study notes the asymmetry of clinical context and is a small exploratory assessment.
